en: Her pace slackened, as soon as she saw me, (turn) I feasted on her and deprived her of her attire. Then she went to the Great-father's place, like a crumpled lotus.

sa: किमयं बध्यते तात त्वयावध्येन दैवतैः। हत एव ह्ययं लोको यदा मृत्युवशं गतः।७।।
en: Why, my child, do you slay these*; you are incapable of being slain by even the celestials. All these (men) are subject to death, they are verily slain. *i.e. human being.

sa: दिष्ट्या जीवसि वैदेहि राक्षसीवशमागता। नचिराद् द्रक्ष्यसे राम लक्ष्मणं च महारथम्॥ मध्ये वानरकोटीनां सुग्रीवं चामितौजसम्। अहं सुग्रीवसचिवो हनूमान् नाम वानरः॥
en: Blessed are we, O Vaidehi, that you do still live, subject as you are to the Raksasis. You shall soon behold Rāma, and Lakşmaņa of a mighty car, and Sugrīva of unmitigated prowess in the midst of the million of monkey hosts. I am Sugrīva's minister, by name Hanumān.

sa: एते दुष्प्रसहा सिताः वीरा येषां संख्या न विद्यते। यूथपा यूथपश्रेष्ठास्तेषां यूथानि भागशः॥
en: These are the heroes, incapable of being borne, whose numbers cannot be enumerated. These are the leaders and the heads thereof, as well as the forces set in order of battle.

sa: मुहूर्तेन यमं ते तु हया हरिहयोपमाः। प्रापयन्मनसस्तुल्या यत्र तत्प्रस्तुतं रणम्॥ दृष्ट्वा तथैव विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम्। सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सहसा विप्रदुर्दुवुः॥
en: In a moment those horses like to thought (in celerity,) and resembling the steeds themselves of Hari, took Yama where the warfare had already begun. Seeing the frightful car in that aspect with Death present in it, the ministers of the Rākşasa monarch at once took to their heels.

sa: अनुष्वनति मेदिन्यां पनसः पनसो यथा॥ नाराचैर्बहुभिश्छिन्नः शेते दयाँ दरीमुखः। कुमुदस्तु महातेजा निष्कूलन्सायकैर्हतः॥
en: Panasa is rolling on the earth like a (veritable) Panasa. And mangled by many iron arrows, Darīmukha lies in a cave. And the exceedingly energetic Kumuda, dumb, is slain by shafts.

sa: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ॥ इहोपयानं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम्। भवदागमनं श्रुत्वा सहैभिर्वनचारिभिः॥ प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टोऽसौ वनं श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम्।
en: O innocent prince, I have related all about this to your uncle. When I described to him, the arrival of all these forest rangers, as well as of yours accompanied by them, and the destruction of this garden by you all, he was not the least offended, rather delighted.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि। किं करोमि कथं वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम्॥
en: I have related to you all this. Do you be consoled, O Maithili! Tell me now, what am I to do and what do you like. I shall soon repair hence.

sa: कथंचिद् भवती दृष्टा न काल: परिशोचितुम्। इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि शोभने ॥
en: Now that I have been able to obtain a sight of you, this is not season for sorrow. O auspicious one, even now you shall witness the end of this woe.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते। श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः॥
en: The great One said Those that constantly adore me, fixing their minds on me, and being endued with the highest faith, are considered by me as men having the greatest devotion.

sa: तव दोषेण युद्धं च प्रवृत्तं सह पाण्डवैः। त्वमेवाद्य फलं भुक्षे कृत्वा किल्बिषमात्मना॥
en: And it is through your fault also that this battle with the Pandavas has been brought about. Do you now reap the fruit of that sin which you have already committed.

sa: सनाथमिव मन्येऽहं भवता पालितं बलम्। अत्र किं नु समर्थे यद्धितं तत् सम्प्रधार्यताम्॥
en: I consider this army, protected by you, to have found a suitable commander in you. Do you now decide that which will be beneficial (to this army) and which is practicable.

sa: न्यषीदत् स्वरथोपस्थे शोणितेन परिप्लुतः। ततः पुनरमेयात्मा नाराचान् दश पञ्च च॥ भूरिश्रवसि संक्रुद्धः प्राहिणोद् भरतर्षभ। ते वर्म भित्त्वा तस्याशु विविशुर्धरणीतलम्॥
en: Then Vikarna, bathed in blood, squatted down on the terrace of his car. Thereafter that Rakshasa of infinite soul, excited with wrath, speed, O foremost of the Bharatas, five and ten dares at Bhurishravas; and these dares penetrating through the latter's Armour struck on the surface of the earth.

sa: परीतबुद्धिर्हि विसंज्ञकल्पो दुर्योधनो न च तच्छ्रद्दधाति। स शेष्यते वै निहतश्चिराय शास्त्रातिगो भीमवलाभिभूतः॥
en: Raft of his reason, and like one senseless, Duryodhana then disregarded our words. Past all counsel, he shall have soon to lie on the field crushed by the might of Bhishma.”

sa: सा च संयमनी नूनं सदा सुकृतिनां गतिः॥ स्वभाभि सिता रम्या त्वयात्पर्थं विराजते।
en: Surely the mansion of Death, that goal of persons of pious deeds. That delightful palace, has today been illumined by your splendour and so has been made highly charming by you.

sa: किं नु संजय संग्रामे वृत्तं दुर्योधनं प्रति। परिदेवो महानद्य श्रुतो मे नाभिनन्दनम्॥
en: What, O Sanjaya, has befallen, unto Duryodhana in this day's battle? A great grief stares us in the face. I do not hear any longer, sounds of joy (from my camp).

sa: स मुक्तो न्यपतत् तूर्णं सव्ये पार्श्वे महाहवे। येनाहं भृशमुद्विग्नो व्याघूर्णित इव दुमः॥
en: In that great battle that arrow, shot by him, quickly fell on my right side owing to which I was as much agitated as a tree is shaken by a gale.

sa: ततः पद्मायुतं तात मृगैः सह चचार सा। पुनर्गत्वा ततो नन्दा पुण्यां शीतामलोदकाम्॥
en: Then she roved for ten times ten thousand billions of years with the animals. Then once again repairing to the holy river Nanda that was full of cool and translucent water.

sa: संजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा भीष्मं रणे क्रुद्धं पाण्डवैरभिसंवृतम्। यथा मेधैर्महाराज तपान्ते दिवि भास्करम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding, O king, Bhishma inflamed with rage in battle, surrounded by the Pandavas, like the sun in the heavens surrounded by the clouds at the end of the summer,

sa: भवान् धर्मपरो नित्यं भवान् धर्मे व्यवस्थितः। स नो रक्ष महाप्रज्ञ त्रिदशानिव वज्रभृत्॥
en: You are ever virtuously inclined, you are ever adopting a pious course; therefore do you, O you of great wisdom, protect us as the wielder of the thunder-bolt protects the gods.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा तेषु निवृत्तेषु प्रत्युद्यातेषु भागशः। स्वयमभ्यद्रवन् भीमं नागानीकेन ते सुतः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the Pandavas did return to the charge and when divisions clashed against divisions, your son (Duryodhana) himself at the head of the elephant division, rushed at Bhimasena. son

sa: ऋतुकाले स्वकां भार्यां गच्छतां या मनीषिणाम्। परस्त्रीभ्यो निवृत्तानां तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक॥
en: May you attain, O son, to the end of those who hold sexual intercourse with their own wives during their seasons, of those who restrain themselves from enjoying others; wives! even

sa: प्रकाशौ च पुनस्तूर्णं बभूवतुरुभौ रणे। तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाश्चारणाश्चर्षिभिः सह॥ अन्योन्यं प्रत्यभाषन्त तयोर्दृष्ट्वा पराक्रमम्। न शक्यौ युधि संरब्धौ जेतुमेतौ कथञ्चन॥ सदेवासुरगन्धर्वैर्लोकैरपि महारथौ। आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेषु युद्धमेतन्महाद्भुतम्॥
en: Soon again both of them became visible. Seeing their great prowess, the Gandharvas, the Charanas, the great Rishis and the celestials thus spoke to one another, “Those (two) great car-warriors, when angry, are incapable of being vanquished cven by all the worlds including the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Asuras. This exceedingly wonderful battle will be considered wonderful by all the worlds”.

sa: नातः कार्यतमं मन्ये रणे भीष्मस्य रक्षणात्। हन्याद् गुप्तो ह्यसौ पार्थान् सोमकांश्च समुंजयान्॥
en: I do not think there is any thing more important in this battle than the protection of Bhishma. If properly protected he will kill the Pandavas, the Somakas and the Srinjayas.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच उक्तो द्वीपस्य संक्षेपो विधिवद् बुद्धिमंस्त्वया। तत्त्वज्ञश्चासि सर्वस्य विस्तरं ब्रूहि संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, you are intelligent, you know the truth, you have duly given me in brief the description of the island. Tell us now of the island in detail.

sa: निर्जिते मयि युद्धेन रणे जेष्यथ पाण्डवाः। क्षिप्रं मयि प्रहरध्वं यदीच्छथ रणे जयम्॥
en: When I shall be slain in battle, the Pandavas will surely win victory, in battle. Smite me down without delay, if you at all long to have victory in this war.

sa: प्राहिणोत् तस्य नागस्य प्रमुखे नृपसत्तम। वर्म मुख्यं तनुत्राणं शातकुम्भपरिष्कृतम्॥ विदार्य प्राविशन् क्षिप्रं वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः। स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो नागो भरतसत्तम॥
en: Struck, O foremost of men, the elephant of the Dasharna king; these lances penetrating the fine Armour and caparisons of gold covering the elephant's body, entered into it like snakes entering into their holes on ant-hills. That elephant, O foremost of the Bharatas, thus deeply pierced and extremely pained,

sa: हताश्वात् सरथाद् राजन् गृह्य चर्म महाबलः। अभ्यायाद् भीमसेनं तु मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Then like an infuriated clephant rushing at an infuriated rival, the puissant Vivinsati, grasping a buckler, jumped down from his car the steeds of which had been slain and assaulted Bhimasena.

sa: अथवा भाव्यमेवं हि संजयैतेन सर्वथा। पुरा धात्रा यथा सृष्टं तत् तथा नैतदन्यथा॥
en: Or it may be, O Sanjaya, that all this had been predestined by the Creator; and what is pre-ordained by him must happen as ordained and can not be other wise.

sa: वक्तुमर्हति सत्यं स त्वया पृष्टो विशेषतः। ते वयं तत्र गच्छामः प्रष्टुं कुरुपितामहम्॥
en: It behooves him to speak the truth, specially when questioned by you. Therefore let us go to the grandşire of the Kurus for asking him about the means of his death.

sa: धिग् भीष्मं धिक् च मे मन्दं पितरं मूढचेतसम्। येनाहं वीर्यशुल्केन पण्यस्त्रीव प्रचोदिता॥
en: Shame on Bhishma, shame on my idiotic father of foolish heart that fixed velour to be my dower as if I were a woman who could be sold at a price,

sa: तथाभियामि संग्रामं न जीयेयं जयामि च। तेन सत्येन संग्रामे हतं विद्धि जयद्रथम्॥
en: I will proceed to battle in such a manner that I will surely win and not lose. When I have taken the oath, count Jayadratha already among those slain in battle.

sa: ध्रुवं प्रज्वलितो घोरमपसव्यं प्रवर्तते। रोहिणी पीडयत्येवमुभौ च शशिभास्करौ। चित्रास्वात्यन्तरे चैव विष्ठितः परुषग्रहः॥
en: The constellation Dhruva, fearfully blazing, advances towards the right. Both the sun and the moon distress Rohini. The terrible planet Rahu has taken up its position between Chitra and Svati (constellations).

sa: साध्विदं कथ्यते वीरा यद्येवं पतिरद्य वः। युध्यध्वं सहिता यत्ता निहनिष्यामि वो रणे॥
en: You have spoken well o heroes; if indeed this be your desire, fight with me in a body putting forth all your endeavors. I will slay all of you in battle.

sa: ब्रूयास्त्वं वासुदेवं च पाण्डवानां समीपतः। आत्मार्थं पाण्डवार्थं च यत्ता मां प्रति योधय॥
en: You should also say to Vasudeva in the hearing to the son of Pandu. For your own sake, and for the sake of Pandavas fight with me with all your power.

sa: न हि शुद्ध्यति मे भावो दृष्ट्वा स्वजनमाकुलम्। अपि पाञ्चालराजस्य विराटस्य च मानद॥
en: Seeing my own people distressed with sorrow, my mind does not obtain peace. Does everything fare well, o bestower of honour, with the Panchala king or the ruler of the Viratas.

sa: सत्त्वकर्मान्वयैर्बुद्ध्या कीर्त्या च यशसा श्रिया। नैव भूतो न भविता नैव तुल्यगुणः पुमान्॥
en: In righteousness, in deeds, in lineage, in intelligence, in renown, in fame and in prosperity-in all these virtues, there neither was nor is, nor will be, a person equal to Yudhishthira.

sa: सा भीष्मे प्रतिकर्तव्यमहं पश्यामि साम्प्रतम्। तपसा वा युधा वाऽपि दुःखहेतुः स मतः॥
en: I now see that for the present I should have revenge on that Bhishma either by austerities or by battle, for in my opinion he is the cause of my misery.

sa: नातः कार्यतमं मन्ये रणे भीष्मस्य रक्षणात्। हन्याद् गुप्तो ह्यसौ पार्थान् सोमकांश्च समुंजयान्॥
en: I do not think there is any thing more important in this battle than the protection of Bhishma. If properly protected he will kill the Pandavas, the Somakas and the Srinjayas.

sa: रौद्रं धनुर्वरं श्रेष्ठं लेभे यद् रोहिणीसुतः। तत् तुष्टः प्रददौ रामः सौभद्राय महात्मने॥
en: That foremost of bows of best make called Rudra which the son of Rohini had obtained, that bow was given, out of delight, to the highsouled son of Subhadra, by Rama.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच पश्य राधेय पञ्चालान् प्रणुन्नान् द्रोणसायकैः। सिंहेनेव मृगान् वन्यां स्त्रासितान् दृढधन्वना॥
en: Duryodhana said Behold, O son of Radha, the ranks of the Panchalas shattered by the shafts of Drona, the resolute bowman, like a herd of wild deer frightened by a lion.

sa: तेषां बहुत्वात् तु भृशं शराणां दिशश्च सर्वाः पिहिता बभूवुः। न भास्करोऽदृश्यत रश्ममाली।
en: In consequence of those various arrows flying in all directions, all sides completely enshrouded. Neither the sky, nor the directions, nor the earth, nor the brilliant sun could be seen. were

sa: त्वत्कृते चैव कर्णोऽपि न्यस्तशस्त्रो विशाम्पते। न युध्यति रणे पार्थं हितकाम: सदा मम॥
en: O king, it is only for you that Karna has laid aside his weapons and does not fight with the son of Pritha, though he is a great friend of mine.

sa: भीम उवाच इदं मे वाक्यमादध्वं क्षत्रिया लोकवासिनः। नोक्तपूर्वं नरैरन्यैर्न चान्यो यद् वदिष्यति॥
en: Bhima said O Kshatriyas, O men of the world, listen to my these words, words never before uttered by any man or will be (ever) uttered by any man in future.

sa: लोमश उवाच सा तु नाव्याश्रमं चक्रे राजकार्यार्थसिद्धये। संदेशाच्चैव नृपतेः स्वबुद्ध्या चैव भारत॥
en: Lomasha said: O descendant of Bharata, in order to accomplish the king's works, she made a floating hermitage, both because the king ordered it and because it agreed with her opinion.

sa: मातुलं प्रीतिपूर्वेण शल्यं चक्रे वशे बली। स तेन सत्कृतो राज्ञा सत्कारार्हो विशाम्पते॥
en: The hero made his uncle Shalya to accept cheerfully their (the Pandava's) sway, o king, deserving as he was of his uncle's hospitality and entertainment, he was well entertained by him.

sa: ते सत्त्वं हि मूलमर्थस्य वितथं यदतोऽन्यथा। न तु प्रसक्तं भवति वृक्षच्छायेव हैमनी॥
en: Prowess is the root of wealth; whatever else is called its root is not so. As the shade of the tree in winter is useless, so is everything fruitless without prowess.

sa: समीरणेनाथ समो बलेन समीरणस्यैव सुतो बलीयान्। स धर्मपाशेन सितोऽचजेन ध्रुवं विनिःश्वस्य सहत्यमर्षम्॥
en: The mighty son of Vayu (Bhima) who is equal to Vayu himself in strength certainly sighs and restrains his wrath tied through his eldest brother (Yudhishthira) to the bond of truth.

sa: गतो हरण्यादपि शक्रलोकं धनंजयः पश्यत वीर्यमस्य। अस्त्राणि दिव्यानि चतुर्विधानि ज्ञात्वा पुनर्लोकमिमं प्रपन्नः॥
en: Behold what great is the prowess of Arjuna who went to the abode of Indra from the forest. Having secured the four kinds of celestials weapons, he has returned to earth.

sa: हत्वा वा मां नयस्वैनां हतो वाद्येह स्वप्स्यसि। तदा ब्रुवति माद्रेये भीमसेनो यदृच्छया।॥
en: Either after having killed me today, carry this lady away or being killed by me, lie senseless here. When the son of Madri (Sahadeva) was thus speaking, Bhimasena, roaring at pleasure,

sa: विलज्जमाना वस्त्रान्तं जग्राहायतलोचना। स्कन्ध देशेऽसृजत् तस्य स्रजं परमशोभनाम्॥ वरयामास चैवैनं पतित्वे वरवर्णिनी।
en: The bashful and larged-eyed maiden held the flying-end of her cloth and put a most handsome garland round his neck. Thus the . fair-faced damsel had chosen him as his lord.

sa: विदुर उवाच गान्धारराजः शकुनिर्विशाम्पते। राजातिदेवी कृतहस्तो मताक्षः। विविंशतिश्चित्रसेनश्च राजा सत्यव्रतः पुरुमित्रो जयश्च॥
en: Vidura said. O king, expert in dice, with great skill of hand, even desperate at stakes the Gandhara king, Shakuni, Vivingshati, Chitrasena, king Satyavrata, Purumitra and Jaya (these are present there).

sa: समेत्य राज्ञा तु सुबाहुना सूतैर्विशोकप्रमुखैश्च सर्वे। सहेन्द्रसेनैः परिचारिकैश्च पौरोगवैर्ये च महानसस्था:॥ ते
en: Meeting with King Subahu and joined by their charioteers with Vishoka at their head, by all their attendants together with Indrasena, by the porters and by the servants of the kitchen,

sa: जनमेजय उवाच भगवन् काम्यकात् पार्थे गते मे प्रपितामहे। पाण्डवाः किमकुर्वंस्ते तमृते सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : O exalted one, when my great-grandfather, the son of Pritha (Arjuna) had gone away from the Kamyaka, what did the Pandavas do in the absence of Savyasachi (Arjuna)?

sa: पीनांस्तुषारान् दरदांश्च सर्वान् देशान् कुलिन्दस्य च भूमिरलान्। अतीत्य दुर्गं हिमवत्प्रदेशं पुरं सुबाहोर्ददृशुर्नृवीराः॥
en: Journeying through China, Turaska, Darada and all the provinces of Kulinda, rich in heaps of jewels and crossing the inaccessible Himalayan regions, those warriors (at length) beheld the capital of Subahu.

sa: स शक्रवज्राभिहतः पपात महासुरः काञ्चनमाल्यधारी। यथा महाशैलवरः पुरस्तात् स मन्दरो विष्णुकराद् विमुक्तः॥
en: Struck with Vajra, that great Asura adorned with garlands of gold, fell down as the great Mandara mountain did in the days of yore when hurled from the hand of Vishnu.

sa: त्वया हि तीर्थेषु पुरा समाप्लावः कृतोऽसकृत्। तपश्चेदं महत् तप्तं स्वर्ग गन्तासि पाण्डव॥
en: O Pandava, as you formerly performed ablutions in various Tirthas (i.e. sacred places resorted to by pilgrims) and were absorbed in rigid asceticism, you will be able to go to heaven.

sa: भूयश्च योधयामासुः कृत्वा कर्णमथाचतः। महता रथसङ्ग्रेन रथचारेण चाप्युत॥ वैकर्तनं परीप्सन्तो गन्धर्वान् समवाकिरन्।
en: With the desire of supporting Karna, the (Kuru) princes attacked the Gandharva army. With a very large number of cars and horses, the whole of the Gandharva army began to fight.

sa: एवं मे वर्तमानस्य स्वसुतेष्वितरेषु च। भेदो न भविता लोके भेदमूलो हि विग्रहः॥
en: If I live in this way, making no distinction between my own sons and those of others, there will be no disagreement in the world. Disagreement is the cause of war.

sa: सदक्षिणस्य भुक्तस्य द्विजस्य तु करे गतम्। यद् वारि वारिणा सिञ्चत् तद्ध्येनस्तरते क्षणात्॥
en: If the water that is in the hands of a Brahmana who has been fed and honoured with Dakshina be sprinkled (on the feeder), then all his sins are instantly destroyed.

sa: जनेन क्लिश्यते बाला दुःखिता शरणार्थिनी। तादृग् रूपं च पश्यामि विद्योतयति मे गृहम्॥
en: The Queen-mother also saw her, vexed by the people, helpless, overpowered by sorrows and seeking for protection, but the splendour of her beauty was such that it illumined the whole palace.

sa: अर्चितानि च सर्वाणि देवतायतनानि च। ऋतुपर्णोऽपि सुश्राव बाहुकच्छद्मिनं नलम्॥ दमयन्त्या समायुक्तं जहषे च नराधिपः। तमानाय्य नलं राजा क्षमयामास पार्थिवम्॥
en: The temples of gods, too, were adorned with flowers. While all this had happened, the foremost king Rituparna became highly gratified to hear that Nala, in the guise of Bahuka, was united with Damayanti. He then called Nala, the ruler of the earth, before him; and begged his pardon.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच सर्वे राज्ञो मैथिलस्य मैनाकस्येव पर्वताः। निकृष्टभूता राजानो वत्सा अनडुहो यथा॥
en: As all other mountains are inferior to the Mainakas, as calves are inferior to the ox, so are all the others kings of the earth inferior to the king of Mithila.

sa: विदुर उवाच युधिष्ठिर विजानीहि ममेदं भरतर्षभ। नाधर्मेण जितः कश्चिद् व्यथते वै पराजय॥
en: Vidura said O Yudhisthira, O best of the Bharata race, know this to be my opinion that he who is defeated by sinful means need not be pained for such defeat.

sa: मन्ये स्वयंवरकृते लोकपालाः समागताः॥ प्रत्याख्याता मया तत्र नलस्यार्थाय देवताः। नूनं तेषां प्रभावेण वियोगं प्राप्तवत्यहम्॥ एवमादीनि दुःखार्ता सा विलप्य वराङ्गना। प्रलापानि तदा तानि दमयन्ती पतिव्रता॥
en: On the occasion of the Svayamvara, the assembled divine guardians of the worlds were neglected by me, for the sake of king Nala; and surely I think. it is through their potent interference, that I have been suffering from this separation.' That fair complexioned Damayanti, devoted to her husband, uttering these words of grief, became greatly afflicted with sorrows and looked pale.

sa: तस्यां देवर्षिजुष्टायां नैमिषं नाम भारत। यत्र तीर्थानि देवानां पुण्यानि च पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in that country there is a Tirtha ever frequented by the celestials Rishis called Naimisha. In that Tirtha there are several separate Tirthas sacred to the celestials.

sa: सा वनानि गिरीश्चैव सरांसि सरितस्तथा। पल्वलानि च सर्वाणि तथारण्यानि सर्वशः॥ अन्वेषमाणा भर्तारं नलं रणविशारदम्। महात्मानं कृतास्त्रं च विचरामीह दुःखिता॥
en: I am wandering through the length and breadth of this wood, over mountains, among rivers, lakes, tanks and expanses of water and forests, with a sorrowful heart, in quest of my lord Nala, versed in the tactics of war, skilled in the use of weapons and of high soul.

sa: सुप्तायां दमयन्त्यां तु नलो राजा विशाम्यते। शोकोन्मथितचित्तात्मा न स्म शेते तथा पुरा॥
en: O lord of your subjects! when Damayanti fell asleep, king Nala, owing to his heart and mind being agitated with grief, could not sleep as before (in his days of happiness).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच वासुदेव महाबाहो विस्तरेण महामते। सौभस्य वधमाचक्ष्व न हि तृष्यामि कथ्यतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Vasudeva, O mighty-armed and highminded hero, tell me in detail the account of the death of the king of Saubha I am not as yet fully satisfied.

sa: इत्येष ते ग्रहोद्देशो मानुषाणां प्रकीर्तितः। न स्पृशन्ति ग्रहा भक्तान् नरान् देवं महेश्वरम्॥
en: O king, I have thus described to you all the evil spirits that influence the destiny of man. You who are devoted to the great god (Siva) will never be troubled.

sa: धौम्यं च भीमं च युधिष्ठिरं च यमौ च कृष्णां च दशार्हसिंहः। उवाच दिष्ट्या भवतां शिवेन प्राप्तः किरीटी मुदितः कृतास्त्रः॥
en: Then, the chief of the Dasharhas said to Dhaumya, Bhima, Yudhishthira, the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and Draupadi “it is by your good fortune that Kiriti (Arjuna who wears a coronet on his head) has returned with a merry mind after having been well-versed in the science of weapons."

sa: एवमुक्त्वा जगामाशु वैन्ययज्ञं महातपाः। गत्वा च यज्ञायतनमत्रिस्तुष्टाव तं नृपम्॥ वाक्यैर्मङ्गलसंयुक्तैः पूजयानोऽब्रवीद् वचः।
en: Markandeya continued Saying this, that sage of great devotion, soon repaired to Vainya's sacrifice. And reaching the sacrificial altar he eulogised the king. With noble speeches and then said these words.

sa: त्वं नस्त्राता विधाता च लोकानां लोकभावना त्वत्प्रसादात् समुच्छेदं न गच्छेत् सामरं जगत्॥
en: (They said) “O protector of the world you our Saviour and you are the creator of the world. Through your favour the universe with the immortals may be saved from extermination."

sa: ब्रूयाद् यदेष कौरव्य तत् कार्यमविशङ्कया। अक्रियायां तु कार्यस्य पुत्रं ते शप्स्यते रुषा॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, what he will advise should be done without any hesitation, for if what he will recommend is not done, the Rishi will curse your son in anger.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच ततो विदर्भान् सम्प्राप्तं सायाह्ने सत्यविक्रमम्। ऋतुपर्णं जना राज्ञे भीमाय प्रत्यवेदयन्॥
en: Brihadashva said: Thereupon king Rituparna of undaunted courage had, in the evening, arrived at the city of the Vidharbhas. The people then brought to prince Bhima the intelligence of his arrival.

sa: विभाण्डक उवाच रक्षांसि चैतानि चरन्ति पुत्र रूपेण तेनाद्भुतदर्शनेन। अतुल्यवीर्याण्यभिरूपवन्ति विघ्नं सदा तपसश्चिन्तयन्ति॥
en: Vibhandaka said: O son, they are Rakshashas. They walk about here in wonderfully beautiful forms. Their prowess is matchless and their beauty is extraordinary. They always think think upon obstructing asceticism.

sa: अथर्घ्यशृङ्गं विकृतं समीक्ष्य पुनः पुनः पीड्य च कायमस्य। अवेक्ष्यमाणा शनकैर्जगाम कृत्वाग्निहोत्रस्य तदापदेशम्॥
en: Having seen Rishyashringa over-powered, she again and again pressed him with her body. Casting glances she slowly went away, as if she was going to make offerings to the holy fire.

sa: स विनिश्चित्य बहुधा विचार्य च पुनः पुनः। उत्सर्ग मन्यते श्रेयो दमयन्त्या नराधिप॥
en: O Monarch! thus repeatedly cogitating over this subject and reflecting again and again about it, he (at last) decided the desertion of Damayanti to be the best course open to him.

sa: भो भो निषधराजेन्द्र नल सत्यव्रतो भवान्। अस्माकं कुरु साहाय्यं दूतो भव नरोत्तम॥
en: "O the most exalted of the rulers of the Nishadhas, O Nala, O you who do observe the vow of truth, O the foremost of men, help us; be our messenger."

sa: तथैव कतमद् युद्धं यस्मिन् कृष्णा जिता त्वया। एकवस्त्रा सभां नीता दुष्टकर्मन् रजस्वला॥
en: By what battle did you win Krishna, that, O you of wicked deeds, you did drag her to the assembly when she was in her course and had one cloth on?

sa: तमुवाच सुकेशान्ता कीचकस्य मया कृतः। संगमो नर्तनागारे यथावोचः परंतप॥ शून्यं स नर्तनागारमागमिष्यति कीचकः। एको निशि महाबाहो कीचकं तं निषूदय॥
en: Of auspiciousness, sat by his husband, the descendant of Kuru; that lady of beautiful hair said to him: “O slayer of foes, as directed by you, I have given Kichaka to understand that our meeting shall take place in the theatre hall. Kichaka shall come to that empty dancing-hall.

sa: स हि वेद महाबुद्धिर्दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्यनेकशः। न तु मां विवृतो युद्धे जातु युध्येत पाण्डवः॥
en: He (Arjuna) is a man of great wisdom and knows the use of celestial weapons and many other weapons but that son of Pandu will never encounter me in open fight.

sa: सोऽस्मानुत्थापयामास वाक्येनानेन पक्षिराट्॥ रावणो विदितो मह्यं लङ्का चास्य महापुरी। दृष्टा पारे समुद्रस्य त्रिकूटगिरिकन्दरे॥ भवित्री तत्र वैदेही न मेऽस्त्यत्र विचारणा।
en: But that monarch of birds stirred us up with these words. Ravana is indeed known to me. His mighty capital, Lanka, can be seen across the sea (situate) in a valley of the Trikuta mountains. The princess of Videha must be there. I have no doubt on this point.

sa: न राजा राजवत् किंचित् समाचरति कीचके। दस्यूनामिव धर्मस्ते न हि संसदि शोभते॥
en: The king does not act like a king in the slightest degree towards Kichaka. O king, your conduct is like that of a robber and does not become the royal court.

sa: स मे निर्वाप्य सहसा चक्षुषी शाम्य ते पुनः। तन्नियच्छ महावेगं गमने विनतात्मजः॥
en: Extinguish at once this fire and let your cyes again be brought to their normal state and, O son of Vinata, slacken the great speed you are using in your journey.

sa: वधे नूनं भवेच्छान्तिस्तयोर्वा फाल्गुनस्य च। न तु हन्तार्जुनस्यास्ति जेता चास्य न विद्यते॥
en: The two (Drona and Karna) or the son of Falguna being killed, there will certainly be peace; but there is none who can kill Arjuna, nor one who can conquer him.

sa: सानूनिवारेः संसुप्तान् दृष्ट्वा भ्रातृन् महामतिः। सुखं प्रसुप्तान् प्रस्विनः खिन्नः कष्टां दशां गतः॥
en: And that large hearted one, beholding his brothers sweetly asleep as (they slept peacefully) on the plateaus of mountains perspired profusely, became sorely afflicted and was reduced to a piteous plight,

sa: इतो गत्वा संजय क्षिप्रमेव उपातिष्ठेथा ब्राह्मणान् ये तदर्हाः। विशुद्धवीर्याश्चरणोपपन्नाः कुले जाताः सर्वधर्मोपपन्नाः॥
en: Departing from here, O Sanjaya, you should speedily wait on these Brahmanas, who are endued with the practice of pure energy, born in high family and endued with all the virtues.

sa: न कर्मणा विप्रणाशोऽस्त्यमुत्र पुण्यानां वाप्यथवा पापकानाम्। पूर्वं कर्तुर्गच्छति पुण्यपापं पश्चात् त्वेनमनुयात्येव कर्ता॥
en: Here (i.e. in the other world) there is no absolute annihilation for either virtuous or for vicious deeds. The good and evil deeds go before and the agent only follows them.

sa: साम्ना दानेन वा कृष्ण ये न शाम्यन्ति शत्रवः। योक्तव्यस्तेषु दण्डः स्याज्जीवितं परिरक्षता॥
en: Those enemies, who do not assume an attitude of peace by words of humility or by surrender, ought to be visited with punishment by him who cares to preserve his life.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच योष पार्थो राधेय कृतं कार्यं भवेन्मम। ज्ञाताः पुनश्चरिष्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दान् विशाम्पते॥
en: Duryodhana said If he be Partha, O son of Radha, then my work is fulfilled. If found out the Pandavas shall have to live in the forest for twelve yeas again.

sa: बाहुभ्यामुद्वहेद् भूमि दहेत् क्रुद्ध इमाः प्रजाः। पातयेत् त्रिदिवाद् देवान् योऽर्जुनं समरे जयेत्॥
en: He who defeats Arjuna in battle bears the earth in his two arms; and when wrathful, he could burn up all creatures and could make the gods fall off from heaven.

sa: यक्ष उवाच अरणीसहितं ह्यस्य ब्राह्मणस्य हृतं मया। मृगवेषेण कौन्तेय जिज्ञासार्थं तव प्रभो॥
en: The Yaksha said: O effulgent son of Kunti, it was in order to test you that I, in the shape of a deer, carried off the fire sticks of that Brahmana.

sa: ययातिरुवाच नाहं प्रतिग्रहधनो ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो ह्यहम्। न च मे प्रवणा बुद्धिः परपुण्यविनाशने॥
en: Yayati said I am not a Brahmana and therefore cannot accept wealth (of any sort) from others, and my I heart is not inclined to destroy the religious merit of others.

sa: किं नु ते मनसा ध्यातमशुभं धर्मदूषणम्। न ह्ययं भवतः स्वल्पो व्यभिचारो भविष्यति॥
en: Is it that in your mind you have entertained a thought which is evil and against the dictates of virtue; this is the result of no small wickedness on your part.

sa: गोमायुसंघाश्च नदन्ति रात्रौ रक्षांस्यथो निष्पतन्त्यन्तरिक्षात्। मृगाः शृगाला: शितिकण्ठाश्च काका गृध्रा बकाश्चैव तरक्षवश्च॥
en: At night crowds of jackals make their rejoicing; and from the sky do Rakshasas come down as also the deer and jackals, peacocks and crows and vultures and cranes and wolves.

sa: तस्यां संसदि सर्वेषां क्षत्तारं पूजयाम्यहम्। वृत्तेन हि भवत्यार्यो न धनेन न विद्यया॥
en: Of all the people present in that assembly I honour that Kshatta (Vidura) most; for a man becomes honourable by his habits and not by his wealth, nor by his knowledge.

sa: समाददानः पृथगस्त्रमार्गान् यथाग्निरिद्धो गहन् निदाघे। स्थूणाकर्णं पाशुपतं महास्त्रं ब्राह्मं चास्त्रं यच्च शक्रोऽप्यदान्मे॥
en: I shall fling the great weapons, called Sthuna, Karna, Pashupata and Brahma all of which Shakra gave me, in different directions; as fire in the hot season burns up a forest.

sa: एभिः सहायैः कस्मात् त्वं विषीदसि परंतप। य इमे वलिाणः सेनां जयेयुः समरुद्गणाम्॥
en: Why, then, O tormentor of foes, do you grieve, since you have such supporters, as are capable of vanquishing the forces of the wielder of the thunderbolt together with the Marutas?

sa: एष धाता विधाता च सिद्धिरत्र प्रतिष्ठिता। यमाह कृष्णो दाशार्हः सोऽस्तु नो वाहिनीपतिः॥
en: He is the lord he is the ordainer and on him depends success and let him, who is named by Krishna of the Dasharha race, be the leader of my forces.

sa: ततस्तं प्रत्युवाचाथ मारीचो रक्षसां वरम्॥ किं ते साह्यं मया कार्यं करिष्याम्यवशोऽपि तत्।
en: Then Maricha replied to the king of the Rakshasas. “What service shall I have to render to you? I shall (surely) do it even if I am not equal to it."

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मा भैस्त्वं राजपुत्राग्य क्षत्रियोऽसि परंतप। कथं तु पुरुषव्याघ्र शत्रुमध्ये विषीदसि॥
en: Arjuna said O foremost of princes, O slayer of foes, be not afraid; you are a Kshatriya; why do you look sorry, O foremost of men, in the midst of enemies?

sa: ब्रूया माधव राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। भूयास्ते हीयते धर्मो मा पुत्रक वृथा कृथाः॥
en: Your virtue is becoming less and less o son; act in such a way that this may not be; fie to them, O Vasudeva, that live under the protection of others.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच अहमिन्द्रो देवराजस्तक्षन् विदितमस्तु ते। कुरुष्वैतदद् यथोक्तं मे तक्षन् माऽत्र विचारय॥
en: Indra said I am Indra, the chief among the gods, let it be known to you O wood cutter. Do as I have told you. O wood cutter, do not ponder.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच भीष्मेणोक्ते ततो द्रोणो दुर्योधनमभाषत। मध्ये नृपाणां भद्रं ते वचनं वचनक्षमः॥
en: Vasudeva said Bhishma having spoken thus, Drona, who was competent to speak, spoke these words to Duryodhane in the midst of those rulers of men. May it be well with you.

sa: न मनुष्ये गुणः कश्चिद् राजन् सधनतामृते। अनातुरत्वाद् भद्रं ते मृतकल्पा हि रोगिणः॥
en: In a man no quality develop, O king, without wealth; but you can gain your object owing to immunity from disease. Those that are suffering from disease are like the dead.

sa: वेद चास्त्रं भरद्वाजाद् दुर्धर्षः सत्यसङ्गरः। यो नित्यं स्पर्धते द्रोणं भीष्मं चैव महाबलम्॥
en: He who learnt the handing of weapons from Bharadvaja, he who is hard to vanquish and ever devoted to truth, who ever challenges Drona as also Bhishma endued with great strength,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं त्वं माधवं वेत्थ सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्। कथमेनं न वेदाहं तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How have you come to know, Madhava, the great lord of all the worlds; and how is it that I do not know him? Tell me that, O Sanjaya.

sa: सर्वथा वृजिनं युद्धं को जन् न प्रतिहन्यते। हतस्य च हृषीकेश समौ जयपराजयौ।॥
en: In all cases fight is an evil. Who that strikes is not struck in return? But victory and defeat, O Hrishikesha, are of the same moment to one that is killed.

sa: न पुत्रफलभोक्ता हि राजर्षे पात्यते दिवः। न याति नरकं घोरं यथा गच्छन्त्यनात्मजाः॥
en: A man, enjoying the fruit of begetting a son, O royal Rishi, never falls down from heaven and never goes to the terrific hell where goes he who has no child."

sa: सावित्र्युवाच अस्मिन्नद्य वने दग्धे शुष्कवृक्षः स्थितो ज्वलन्। वायुना धम्यमानोऽत्र दृश्यतेऽग्निः क्वचित् क्वचित्।।७८
en: Savitri said: There is a withered tree in a burning state in this forest which caught fire today. And the flames stirred up by the wind are seen now and then.

sa: विस्मितान्यथ भूतानि तौ दृष्ट्वा संयुगे तदा। साधु पार्थ महाबाहो साधु भीष्मेति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: All spectators to that battle could not resist them saying frequently, Ogreat warrior Partha! we thank you. O great warrior Bhishma! We thank you (viz. we appreciate your war-craft and expertise).

sa: कृतार्था भुञ्जते दूताः पूजां गृह्णन्ति चैव ह। कृतार्थं मां सहामात्यं समर्चिष्यसि भारत॥
en: “Those messengers only, who have gained their objects take their food and accept worship; and you, O Bharata, after gratifying me in my wish, may entertain me along with my followers'.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच त्वमेव पुण्डरीकाक्ष सर्वस्य जगतो हितः। तस्मात् त्वं यादवश्रेष्ठ प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said "You are the doer of good to the entire world, O you of lotus eyes, therefore it is proper that you should bless me, you foremost among the Yadavas.

sa: राजोवाच अविचाल्यं तदुक्तं यत् तथ्यं भगवता वचः। करिष्याम्येतदेवं च गुरुर्हि भगवान् मम॥
en: The King said: The words of your respectable self are true and should never be dishonoured. Since O adorable one, you are my preceptor I will do as directed by you.

sa: यो वेद वेदान् स च वेद वेद्यं न तं विदुर्वेदविदो न वेदाः। तथापि वेदेन विदन्ति वेदं ब्राह्मणा वेदविदो भवन्ति।॥
en: He who knows the proofs knows also that which is sought to be proved; but the true essence and nature thereof neither the Vedas, nor those conversant with the Vedas know. Still those twice-born that are conversant with the Vedas know the knowable Being by means of the Vedas.

sa: तदने राजधर्मान् हि मदर्थे त्वं पितामह। प्रब्रूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ त्वं हि धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Therefore, O grandfather, do you, for my sake, discourse on royal duties first of all, for you, O chief of the Bharatas, are the foremost of all persons conversant with duties.

sa: दुर्लभः स मया द्रष्टुं नूनं परमधार्मिकः। एकः पुत्रो महारण्ये नष्ट इत्यसकृत् तदा॥
en: Addressing the emaciated Rishi he said,-Forsooth, that highly virtuous son of mine cannot be traced by me. Alas, he was my only son. He is lost and can nowhere be found.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच एतस्य विततस्तात सुदेवस्य बभूव ह। संग्रामयज्ञः सुमहान् यश्चान्यो युद्ध्यते नरः॥
en: Indra said About this Sudeva, Osire, the great sacrifice of battle had often been performed by him. And such becomes the case with every other man who engages himself in battle.

sa: त्रिवर्गश्चापि यः प्रोक्तस्तमिहैकमनाः शृणु। क्षयः स्थानं च वृद्धिश्च त्रिवर्गः परमस्तथा॥ धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च सेवितव्योऽथ कालतः। धर्मेण च महीपालश्चिरं पालयते महीम्॥
en: Listen now with attention to what are the triple objects. They are decrease, maintenance of what is, and growth. The great three fold objects consist of religion, Profit and Pleasure. These should be followed judiciously. By the help of religion a king succeeds in ruling the Earth for ever.

sa: भवान् पिता भवान् माता भवान् भ्राता भवान् गुरुः। दुःखप्रलापानार्तस्य तन्मे त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: You are my father, you are my protector, you are my brother, and you my senior and preceptor. You should, therefore, forgive these incoherent utterances in sorrow of a woestricken person.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं धर्मे स्थातुमिच्छन् नरो वर्तेत भारत। विद्वन् जिज्ञासमानाय प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said How, O Bharata, should a person act who wishes to follow virtue? O foremost of Bharata's race, learned as you are, enlighten me on the question put by me.

sa: श्रियं हित्वा प्रदीप्तां त्वं श्ववत् सम्प्रति वीक्ष्यसे। अपुत्रा जननी तेऽद्य कौसल्या चापतिस्त्वया॥
en: Forsaking your blazing prosperity, you look about like a dog for his food. Your mother has to-day been made sonless by you, and your wife, the princess of Koshala, a widow.

sa: स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि दूरादपि तवोद्विजे॥ विश्वस्तं वा प्रमत्तं वा एतदेव कृतं भवेत्।
en: If you think that I have done you a service, do me a friend's work when I may happen to move trustfully or carelessly. Even that will be gratitude in you.

sa: अपि वा पञ्च षट् सप्त संहताः कृतनिश्चयाः। कुलीनाः पूजिताः सम्यग् विजयन्तीह शात्रवान्॥
en: Sometimes even five, or six, or seven men, firm and standing close together, of high birth and esteemed of those that know them, defeat enemies much superior to them in number.

sa: अन्यया यौवने मयों बुद्ध्या भवति मोहितः। मध्येऽन्यया जरायां तु सोऽन्यां रोचयते मतिम्॥
en: A man, in youth, had one kind of understanding. In middle age, he has not the same, and in the period of decay, a different kind of understanding prevails in him.

sa: बाह्रीकद्रोणभीष्माणां कर्णस्य च महात्मनः। जयद्रथस्य शूरस्य भगदत्तस्य चोभयोः॥ मद्रराजस्य शल्यस्य भूरिश्रवस एव च। पुत्राणां भरतश्रेष्ठ शकुनेः सौबलस्य च॥ मित्राणां सुहृदां चैव बान्धवानां तथैव च।
en: Today I shall release myself from the debt I woe to the many illustrious Kshatriyas, to Valhika and Drona and Bhishma and the great Karna, to the heroic Jayadratha and Bhagadatta, to Shalya the ruler of the Madras and Bhurishravas, to my sons, O best of Bharata's race and Shakuni the son of Subala, to all my friends and well-wishers and relatives.

sa: भासा हंसाः सुपर्णाश्च चक्रवाका: प्लवा बकाः। काको मद्गुश्च गृधश्च श्येनोलूकस्तथैव च॥ क्रव्यादा दंष्ट्रिणः सर्वे चतुष्पात् पक्षिणश्च ये। येषां चोभयतो दन्ताश्चतुर्दंष्ट्राश्च सर्वशः॥ एडकाश्वखरोष्ट्रीणां सूतिकानां गवामपि।
en: A Brahmana should not also take waterfowls called Bhasas, ducks, Suparnas, Chakravakas, diving ducks, cranes, crow, shags, vultures, hawks, owls, as also all fourlegged carnivorous animals and that have sharp and long teeth, and birds, and animals having two teeth and those having four teeth, as also the milk of the sheep, the she-ass, the shecamel, the newly-calved cow, women and dear.

sa: न त्वन्यामिह मार्जाराद् गतिं पश्यामि साम्प्रतम्। विषमस्थो ह्ययं शत्रुः कृत्यं चास्य महन्मया॥
en: At present, however, I do not see any other refuge than this cat. He is an enemy. But he is in difficulty. The service that I can do him is verygreat.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आभ्यन्तरे प्रकुपिते बाह्ये चोपनिपीडिते। क्षीणे कोशे श्रुते मन्त्रे किं कार्यमवशिष्यते॥
en: What should a king do when his own people are dissatisfied with him, when he is oppressed by invaders, when his treasury is exhausted and when his counsels are given out?

sa: स राज्यं धृतिमान् प्राप्य धर्मेण परिपालय। इन्द्रं तर्पय सोमेन कामैश्च सुहृदो जनान्॥
en: Endued with intelligence, you have obtained a kingdom. Do you protect your subjects righteously. Please Indra with offerings of Soma and your friends and wellwishers with the objects they desire for.'

sa: ततो रथो घूर्णितवान् नरेन्द्र शापत्तदा ब्राह्मणसत्तमस्य। ततश्चक्रमपतत्तस्य भूमौ स विह्वलः समरे सूतपुत्रः॥
en: Having gone deep into the earth and been clogged there like a holy tree with flowers standing on a high land, Karna's car, on account of the great Brahmana's imprecation reeled.

sa: क्षत्रियास्ते महात्मानः शूराः समितिशोभनाः। आशिषः परमाः प्राप्त न शोर्ध्या सर्व एव हि॥
en: They were all great Kshatriyas; brave as they were, they were ornaments of assemblies. They have attained highest of blessed regions. They are not persons for whom we should be sorry.

sa: काञ्चने लोष्ठभावे च समदर्शी महातपाः। देवानपूजयन्नित्यमतिथींश्च द्विजैः सह॥ ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नित्यं सदा धर्मपरायणः।
en: The great ascetic looked with an equal eye upon gold and pebbles. He daily worshipped the gods and guests and the Brahmanas. Righteous himself he always practised the vow of Brahmacharya

sa: नित्यं राष्ट्रमवेक्षेत गोभिः सूर्य इवोदितः। चरान् स्वनुचरान् विद्यात् तथा बुद्ध्या स्वयं चरेत्।।
en: Like the Sun shedding his rays upon everything underneath, the king should always look after his kingdom himself, and helped by his intelligence, be should supervise all his spies and officers.

sa: उत्तरेण तु पन्थानं नियमाद् यं प्रपश्यसि। एते यागवतां लोका भान्ति पार्थ सनातनाः॥
en: You will see, however, that the northern path is trodden by those who are devoted to Yoga. Those eternal and bright regions to which that path leads is reserved for Yogins.

sa: जलौकावत् पिबेद् राष्ट्र मृदुनैव नराधिपः। व्याघ्रीव च हरेत् पुत्रान् संदशेन्न च पीडयेत्॥
en: The king should act like the leech taking blood mildly. He should treat his subjects like a tigress carrying her cubs, touching them with her teeth but never cutting them therewith.

sa: यदा निवृत्तः सर्वस्मात् कामो योऽस्य हृदि स्थितः। तदा भवति सत्त्वस्थस्ततो ब्रह्म समश्नुते॥
en: When all attachment for every earthly object, is withdrawn from his heart he is then regarded as one leaving in his understanding alone. In this state he soon attains to Brahma.

sa: न ब्रह्मचार्यधीयीत कल्याणी गौर्न दुह्यते। न कन्योद्वहनं गच्छेद् यदि दण्डो न पालयेत्॥
en: If chastisement did not keep up and protect (the world), then no body would have read the Vedas, nobody would have milked a milch cow, and no maiden would have married.

sa: यथा च जामदग्न्येन कोटिशः क्षत्रिया हताः। उद्भूता राजवंशेषु ये भूयो भारते हताः॥
en: Listen to the story of how millions of Kshatriyas were killed by Jamadagni's son and how those that were born again in the various royal houses in Bharata were again killed.

sa: स राज्यं धृतिमान् प्राप्य धर्मेण परिपालय। इन्द्रं तर्पय सोमेन कामैश्च सुहृदो जनान्॥
en: Endued with intelligence, you have obtained a kingdom. Do you protect your subjects righteously. Please Indra with offerings of Soma and your friends and wellwishers with the objects they desire for.'

sa: इत्येवं व्यवहारस्य व्यवहारत्वमिष्यते। अपि चैतत् पुरा राजन् मनुना प्रोक्तमादितः॥ सुप्रणीतेन दण्डेन प्रियाप्रियसमात्मना। प्रजा रक्षति यः सम्यग्धर्म एव स केवलः॥
en: It is, therefore, that the name Vyavahara is applied to it. In days of yore, Manu, O king, declared first of all this truth, viz.,-He who protects all creatures, the loved and the hated equally, by impartially holding the rod of punishment, is said to be the righteousness incarnate.

sa: चरेयुर्नाश्रमे धर्म यथोक्तं विधिमाश्रिताः। न विद्यां प्राप्नुयात् कश्चिद् यदि दण्डो न पालयेत्।।४०
en: If chastisement did not uphold and protect, no one would observe the duties of his own order as sanctioned (in the scriptures), and no one would have succeeded in gaining knowledge.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राष्ट्रगुप्तिं च मे राजन् राष्ट्रस्यैव तु संग्रहम्। सम्यग्जिज्ञासमानाय प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said How, O king, may a kingdom be firmly established, and how should it be protected? I wish to know this. Tell me all this, O foremost of Bharata's race.

sa: जीवन् हि कुरुते पूजां विप्राय: शशिसूर्ययोः। ब्रुवन्नपि कथां पुण्यां तत्र कीट त्वमेष्यसि॥
en: He who becomes a superior Brahmana worships while alive, the deities of the sun and the moon, uttering various sacred Mantras. O worm, you will come by that state of existence.

sa: गावस्तेजः पर प्रोक्तमिह लोके परत्र च। न गोभ्यः परमं किंचित् पवित्रं भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Kine are said to represent the highest energy both in this world and the next. There is nothing that is more sacred or purifying than kine, O chief of the Bharatas.

sa: परेभ्यो न प्रतिग्राह्यं न च देयं कदाचन। दैन्यभावाच्च भूतानां संविभज्य सदा बुधः॥
en: He should not be induced to accept gifts from others, nor should he make gifts to others. Owing to the helplessness of creatures, the wise man should always share with others.

sa: पतितं याजयित्वा तु कृतियोनौ प्रजायते। तत्र जीवति वर्षाणि दश पञ्च च भारत॥
en: A Brahmana, by officiating at the sacrifice of a degraded person, has to take birth as a vile worm. In this form he has to live for fifteen years, O Bharata.

sa: उवाच चैनं मेधावी युड्क्ष्वात्मानमिति प्रभो। ऋषिपुत्रो मनीषी स राजा चक्रेऽस्य तद् वचः॥
en: Gifted with intelligence, Sanjaya said, 'Do you concentrate your mind. O powerful one!' The son of a Rishi, and himself endued with great wisdom, the king acted as he was told.

sa: अस्वामिकस्य स्वामित्वं यस्मिन् सम्प्रति लक्ष्यते। यो वर्ण: पोषयेत् तं च तद्वर्णस्तस्य जायते॥
en: Not having anybody to own him, he becomes his who rcars hiin. Such son, again, comes to be considered as belonging to that castes to which his owner or rearer belongs.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवः पृथिवीपतिः। चकार सर्वे राजेन्द्र यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thius addressed (by the Rishi), Yudhishthira, the royal son of Pandu, answered, 'So be it!' and then, O monarch, he accomplished all that that utterer of Brahma had said.

sa: आहवं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा कच्चिन्न निहतः परैः॥ कच्चिन्मुखं न गोविन्द तेनाजौ विकृतं कृतम्।
en: I hope he has not been killed by eneinies while retreating from battle with his back towards them? I hope, O Govinda, that his face did not become cheerless while fighting?

sa: ऋषि उवाच कथं रक्षामि भवतस्तेऽब्रुवंश्चन्द्रमा भव। तिमिरन्धश्च सवितस दस्युहन्ता च नो भव॥
en: The Rishi said How, indeed, shall I protect you? They answered, saying, Do you become the Moon. Do you also become the Sun, and do you begini to kill these robbers.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि तु संहृत्य मन आत्मनि धारयेत्। तीव्र तप्त्वा तपः पूर्वे मोक्षयोगं समाचरेत्॥
en: Withdrawing the senses from their objects, one should fix the mind upon the soul; having previously practised the severest austerities, one should practise that concentration of mind which leads to Liberation.

sa: भूमौ जायन्ति पुरुषा भूमौ निष्ठां व्रजन्ति च। चतुर्विधो हि लोकोऽयं योऽयं भूमिगुणात्मकः॥
en: Living creatures originate from Earth and it is to the Earth that they return when they disappear. Living creatures which are divided into four classes have Earth for their primordial essence.

sa: दत्तं किं फलवद् राजनिह लोके परत्र च। भवत: श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे विस्तरतो वद॥
en: What gifts, O king; yield rewards both in this world and in the next? I wish to hear all this from you. Do you describe to me all this in detail.

sa: न हि शक्यं त्वया प्राप्तुं ब्राह्मण्यमिह दुर्मते। अप्राप्यं प्रार्थयानो हि नचिराद् विनशिष्यसि॥
en: O you of foolish understanding, it is impossible for you to obtain it in this world, Verily, by coveting that which is unattainable you are sure to meet with destruction forthwith.

sa: त्वया शक्तेन हि सता मिथ्याचारेण माधव। ते परीताः कुरुश्रेष्ठा नश्यन्तः स्म ह्यपेक्षिताः॥
en: It seems, O Madhava, that, though fully able (to save them), you were in different to these foremost of Kurus who, overwhelmed by insincerity and hypocrisy, have all met with destruction.

sa: विष्णु उवाच धर्मगुह्यानि सर्वाणि देवतानां महात्मनान्। ऋषीणां चैव गुह्यानि यः पठेदाह्निकं सदा॥ शृणुयाद् वानसू युर्यः श्रद्दधानः समाहितः। नास्य विघ्नः प्रभवति भयं चास्य न विद्यते॥
en: Vishnu said That person who gifted with faith and freed from malice, listens every day with rapt attention to the mysteries about religion and duty that are preserved by the great deities and those mysteries also of the same kind that are preserved by the Rishis has never to succumb to any evil. Such a person becomes also freed from every fear.

sa: युक्तं हि यशसा क्षात्रं स्वर्ग प्राप्तुमसंशयम्। न हि कश्चिद्धि शूराणां निहतोऽत्र पराङ्मुखः॥
en: It is proper that a Kshatriya should attain the celestial region for certain by his (own) renown. Of heroes, those who came to be killed never shall have to turn away.

sa: त्रयोदशे तु दिवसे प्राप्ते यः प्राशते हविः। सदा द्वादशमासान् वै देवसत्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: That man who having fasted twelve days, eats a little clarified butter on the thirteenth, and acts thus for a whose year, succeeds in acquiring the merits of the divine sacrifice.

sa: केन वा किं ततो हार्यं पितृवित्तात् पितामह। एतदिच्छामि कथितं विभागस्तेषु यः स्मृतः॥
en: Who amongst them, O grandfather shall take what share of the paternal wealth? I wish to hear this, viz., how the distribution has been ordained amongst them of the paternal property.

sa: किमाहाराश्च ते तत्र ससैन्या न्यवसन् प्रभो। सान्त:पुरा महात्मान इति तद् ब्रूहि मेऽनघ॥
en: Of what food, O powerful one, did the great Pandavas support themselves with their men, and wives, while they lived in the forest? O sinless one, do you tell me this.

sa: सूर्ये चक्षुर्दिशः श्रोत्रं प्राणोऽस्य दिवमेव च। आगमे वर्तमानस्य न मे दोषाऽस्ति कश्चन॥
en: His eye will enter the sun; his ear will enter the various points of the horizon; his vital airs will enter the sky. I who follow the scriptures commit no sin.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच इन्द्रः साक्षात् सहसाभ्येतु विप्र हविर्यज्ञे प्रतिगृह्णातु चैव। स्वं स्वं धिष्ण्यं चैव जुषन्तु देवा हुतं सोमं प्रतिगृह्णन्तु चैव॥
en: Marutta said-I wish, O Brahmana, that Indra all of a sudden should come bodily at this sacrifice, and accept the oblation offered to him, and that all the other celestials also come and take their appointed shares of the offerings and accepts the libations of Soma offered to them.

sa: उमोवाच आश्रमाभिरता देव तापसा ये तपोधनाः। दीप्तिमन्तः कया चैव चर्ययाथ भवन्ति ते॥
en: Uma said By what course of duties, O god, do those ascetics who are attached to their respective retreats and have penances for wealth, succeed in becoming indued with great splendour?

sa: ब्रह्माणं सारथिं कृत्वा विनियुज्य च सर्वशः। त्रिपर्वणा त्रिशल्येन तेन तानि बिभेद सः॥
en: And he made the Grandfather Brahman his charioteer. Applying all these, he pierced the triple city of the Asuras with that arrow of his, consisting of three Parvans and three Shalyas.

sa: भीष्म उवाच क्षत्रधर्ममनुप्राप्तः स्मरन्नेव च वीर्यवान्। त्यक्त्वा स कीटतां राजंश्चचार विपुलं तपः॥
en: Bhishma said Having renounced the status of a worm and taken birth as a Kshatriya of great energy, the person remembering his previous changes, O monarch began to practise severe austerities.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच एहि गच्छ प्रहितो जातवेदो बृहस्पतिं परिदातुं मरुत्ते। स्तथाऽमरं चैव करिष्यतीति॥
en: Do you, O Jataveda, following my direction, go to king Maruttato present Brihaspati to him and say to him that this Brihaspati will officiate at his sacrifice and make him immortal.

sa: शप्तानां नो महादेव्या नान्यदस्ति परायणम्। अन्यत्र भवतो वीर्यं तस्मात् त्रायस्व नः प्रभो॥
en: We have been cursed by the great goddess Uma. There is nothing else than your power which can be our refuge now. Do you, therefore, O powerful deity, rescue us all.

sa: वामनं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा वराहं च जलोत्थिम्। उद्धृतां धरणीं चैव मूर्धा धारयते तु यः॥ न तेषामशुभं किंचित् कल्मषं चोपपद्यते। अश्वत्यं रोचनां गां च पूजयेद् यो नरः सदा॥ पूजितं च जगत् तेन सदेवासुरमानुषम्। तेन रूपेण तेषां च पूजां गृह्णामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: They who see a Brahmana that is a dwarf in stature, or a boar that has just risen from water and that bears on his head a quantity of mud taken up from the bank, have never to meet with any evil, They become freed from every sin. That man who adores every day the Ashvattha (Ficus religiosa) and the substance called Gorochana and the cow, is considered as adoring the whole universe with the celestials and Asuras and human beings. Indeed, staying within these, I accept in my own form the adoration that is offered to them.

sa: आयुष्मान् भवते चैव यं श्रुत्वा पार्थिवात्मज। पुरुषस्तु सुसिद्धार्थः प्रेत्य चेह च मोदते॥
en: Indeed, the man who hears it becomes gifted with longevity, O prince, and attaining to the fruition of all his desires, sports happily both in this life and in the next.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच बृहस्पतिं गतः पूर्वमहं संवर्त तच्छृणु। न मां कामयते याज्यमसौ वासवकाम्यया॥
en: Marutta said Do you listen to me, O Samvarta, I did go to Brihaspati first, but wishing the patronage of Vasava, he did not wish to have me as his sacrificer.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा वचनमनुमान्य च पार्थिवम्। तथास्त्विति च तेनोक्तः कौन्तेयेन ययौ वनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, Vyasa, soothed the old king. Yudhishthira, then, answered him, saying, “So be it.' The great ascetic then left the palace for proceeding to the forest.

sa: प्रपितामहाय च तत एष श्राद्धविधिः स्मृतः। ब्रूयाच्छ्राद्धे च सावित्री पिण्डे पिण्डे समाहितः॥
en: Next should one be offered to the greatgrandfather. This is the ordinance relating to Shraddha. Over every cake that is offered, the offer should, with rapt attention, after the Savitri mantras.

sa: अश्व उवाच गुरोगुरुं मां जानीहि ज्वलनं जातवेदसम्। त्वया ह्यहं सदा विप्र गुरोरर्थेऽभिपूजितः॥ विधिवत् सततं विप्र शुचिना भृगुनन्दन। तस्मा यो विधास्यामि तवैवं कुरु मा चिरम्॥
en: The horse said Know, O learned Brahmana, that I am the preceptor of your preceptor, for I am the blazing Jatavedas (deity of fire). By you I was often adored for the sake of your preceptor, O child of Bhrigu's race, duly and with a pure heart and body. I shall therefore accomplish what is for your will-being. Do my bidding forthwith.

sa: तां पूजयित्वा बीभत्सुः प्रसादमकरोत् प्रभुः। शकुनेश्चापि तनयं सान्त्वयन्निदमब्रवीत्॥ न मे प्रियं महाबाहो यत्ते बुद्धिरियं कृता। प्रतियोद्धुममित्रघ्न भ्रातैव त्वं ममानघ॥
en: The powerful Bibhatsu adored her and became inclined to show mercy towards the Gandharas. Comforting the son of Shakuni, he said, You have not, O mightyarmed hero, done what is agreeable to me by adopting these hostile measures! O destroyer of heroes, you are my brother, O sinless one.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य धरां राजन् व्यास: सत्यवतीसुतः॥ अब्रवीद् भरतश्रेष्ठं धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। वसुधा भवतस्त्वेषा संन्यस्ता राजसत्तम॥ निष्क्रयो दीयतां मह्यं ब्राह्मणा हि धनार्थिनः।
en: Satyavati's son Vyasa, having accepted the Earth, addressed that foremost one of Bharata's race, viz., king Yudhishthira the just, and said, O best of kings, the Earth which you have given me I return to you! Do you give me the purchasing value, for Brahmanas are desirous of wealth.

sa: विदुरं पूजयित्वा च वैश्यापुत्रं समेत्य च॥ पूज्यमानाः स्म ते वीरा व्यरोचन्त विशाम्पते।
en: They next adored (their uncle) Vidura and Yuyutsu, the son of Dhritarashtra by his Vaishya wife. Those heroes were then adored by others and they shone forth in beauty, O king.

sa: न जातु त्वमिति ब्रूयादापन्नोऽपि महत्तरम्। त्वंकारो वा वधो वेति विद्वत्सु स विशिष्यते॥
en: One should never address an eminent person familiarly. Under even the greatest difficulties one should never do this. To you such a person are degraded by such a manner of address.

sa: सुवर्णं परमं दानं सुवर्णं दक्षिणा परा। सुवर्णं पावनं शक्र पावनानां परं स्मृतम्॥
en: The gift of gold is the best of gifts. Gold is, again, the best present. Gold is a great purifier. O Shakra, and is, indeed, the best of all purifying objects.

sa: तं प्रेक्ष्य रामः सुभृशमवध्यम च लोपमम्। भयेष्वभयदः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ तपसा पुरुषव्याघ्र राक्षसोऽयं न शक्यते। शस्त्रेण युधि निर्जेतुं राक्षसं निखनावहे॥
en: Seeing him utterly incapable of being killed, and resembling a hill, that inspirer of hope in times of peril, the graceful (Rama), said, O foreinost of men, in consequence of his austerities, yon Rākşasa cannot be vanquished with weapons in conflict. Therefore, let us cast him into a pit.

sa: यथा तु रोपितो वृक्षः पुरुषेण विवर्धितः। ह्रस्वकेन दुरारोहो रूढस्कन्धो महादुमः॥ स यदा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न विदर्शयेत्। स तां नानुभवेत् प्रीतिं यस्य हेतोः प्ररोपितः॥ एषोपमा महाबाहो तदर्थ वेत्तुमर्हसि। यत्र त्वमस्मान् वृषभो भर्ता भृत्यान् न शाधि हि॥
en: As a tree planted by a person, and by him made to increase, (until at last), sending out branches, a mighty tree, it is incapable of being got up by a dwarf; and then if, flowering, it show no fruits, it cannot contribute to the satisfaction of him for whom it has been planted. O mightyarmed one, this comparison is meant for you. This* it behoves you to apprehend, inasmuch as you are our excellent lord, and you do not teach us who depend upon you for support. *The import of the image.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासे न ते राम भविष्येते नरोत्तम। बलामतिबलां चैव पठतस्तात राघव॥ विद्याद्वयमधीयाने यशश्चाथ भवेद् भुवि। पितामहसुते ह्येते विद्ये तेजः समन्विते॥
en: And, O Rāma, O foremost of men, if you recite Bala and Atibala on the way, neither hunger nor thirst will exercise you, O descendant of Raghu! And if you recite these, you will attain fame on earth. Those sciences fraught with energy are the daughters of the Grandsire.

sa: उपविष्टास्तु ते सर्वे यस्मिन् प्रायं गिरिस्थले। हरयो गृध्रराजश्च तं देशमुपचक्रमे॥ सम्पातिर्नाम नाम्ना तु चिरजीवी विहंगमः। भ्राता जटायुषः श्रीमान् विख्यातबलपौरुषः॥
en: When the monkeys had been seated in that mountain, with the intention of putting a period to their existence through fasting a king of vultures happened to come to that quarter. And that long-lived bird was named Sampāti, the beautiful brother of Jaţāyu, famous for his strength and prowess.

sa: ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि गोलाङ्गुलशतानि च। अद्य त्वमुपयास्यन्ति जहि कोपमरिंदम। कोट्योऽनेकास्तु काकुत्स्थ कपीनां दीप्तेजसाम् ॥
en: This very day billions of bears and thousands of golangulas as well as innumerable Koțis of monkeys flaming in energy shall join you. Therefore, O subduer of enemies, banish your anger.

sa: ह्रियमाणौ तु काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा सीता रघूत्तमौ । उच्चैः स्वरेण चुक्रोश प्रगृह्य सुमहाभुजौ॥
en: Seeing those foremost of Raghus, the Kākutsthas, carried away, Sītā carried in a loud voice, raising up her arms. * *Another reading is Subhujābhujau-That one of elegant arms (raising) them up.

sa: जटायुषं तु प्रतिपूज्य राघवो मुदा परिप्वज्य च संनतोऽभवत्। जटायुषा संकथितं पुनः पुनः॥
en: There Rāghava paying homage to Jațāyu, and embracing him jcyfully, bent low; and that selfpossessed one listened to the story of Jațāyu's friendship with his father, as related by him repeatedly.

sa: रामाय चाचचक्षे मां तापसी धर्मचारिणीम्। रात्रिः दश वर्षाण्यनावृष्ट्या दग्धे लोके निरन्तरम्॥ यया मूलफले सृष्टे जाह्नवी च प्रवर्तिता। उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता नियमैश्चाप्यलंकृता॥ दश वर्षसहस्राणि यया तप्तं महत् तपः। अनसूयाव्रतैस्तात प्रत्यूहाश्च निबर्हिताः॥ देवकार्यनिमित्तं च यया संत्वरमाणया। दशरात्रं कृता सेयं मातेव तेऽनघ ॥
en: And Atri related to Rāma matters connected with the female ascetic, engaged in offices of virtue, The people were ceaselessly burning in consequence of a drought extending over ten years. O sinless one, that one resembling your mother is this, by whom furnished with rigid asceticism and adorned with voluntary penances, were created fruits and roots and the Jāhnavi was made to flow through the asylum; by whom were performed mighty austerities for ten thousand years, in virtue of whose pen ances, disturbances to the asceticism of the sages ceased, by whom ten nights were brought within the compass of a single one.

sa: एष कामो दत्तमेव वरं वृणे। अद्य चैव हि पश्येयं प्रयान्तं राघवं वने॥
en: Even this in my prime wish; and I beseech you but to grant the boon you have already promised. Even this very day will I see Rāma despatched to the woods.

sa: मा चास्मै प्रोषितं रामं मा चास्मै पितरं मृतम्। भवन्तः शंसिषुर्गत्वा राघवाणामितः क्षयम्॥
en: But you must on no account communicate to him the exile of Rāma, or the demise of the monarch, or the destruction that has befallen the Raghu race through this occasion.

sa: ततः पश्यति धर्मात्मा तत् सर्वं योगमास्थितः। पुरा यत् तत्र निर्वृत्तं पाणावामलकं यथा॥
en: And like an embolic myrobalan on his palm, that righteous-souled sage by virtue of his yoga, perceived all that had happened as well as all that would happen in the past.

sa: गतिर्यः सर्वभूतानां दुःखे किं पुनरात्मनः। स रामः सत्त्वसम्पन्नः स्त्रिया प्रव्राजितो वनम् ॥
en: Need it be said that Rāma is the refuge both of himself and all creatures in trouble? That Rāma possessed of strength has been exiled into the woods by a woman!

sa: विमुक्तास्तस्य वेगेन मुक्त्वा पुष्पाणि ते दुमाः। व्यवशीर्यन्त सलिले निवृत्ताः सुहृदो यथा।५० ।।
en: And uprooted by the force of his rush, mose trees, their flowers fallen off, plunged into the sea, like friends returning to their homes (after having accompanied their friend some way).

sa: श्रूयतामिह वैदेह्या यथा मे हरणं श्रुतम्। येन चापि ममाख्यातं यत्र चायतलोचना ॥
en: Listen as to how I came to know of the ravishment of Vaidehī, Sītā, at this place; and who it was that told me where that one of expansive eyes is.

sa: संगृह्य पादौ पितुरुग्रतेजा जग्राह मातुः पुनरेव पादौ। पादौ रुमायाश्च निपीडयित्वा निवेदयामास ततस्तदर्थम्॥
en: That one of exceeding prowess first touched the feet of his uncle then saluted again his mother and afterwards touching the feet of Rumā related to them every thing in full.

sa: विधिः किल नरं लोके विधानेनानुवर्तते। यथायं विहितो भक्ष्यश्चिरान्मह्यमुपागतः॥ परम्पराणां भक्षिष्ये वानराणां मृतं मृतम्। उवाचैतद् वचः पक्षी तान् निरीक्ष्य प्लवङ्गमान्॥
en: Verily man reapeth the fruit of his former acts; and therefore it is that this food ordained to that end, comes to me after a long time. I shall feed on these monkeys, one by one, slaying them one after another. Eyeing those apes, the bird expressed himself thus.

sa: तामारुरोह भरतः शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलः। कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च याश्चान्या राजयोषितः॥ पुरोहितश्च तत् पूर्वं गुरवो ब्राह्मणाश्च ये। अनन्तरं राजदारास्तथैव शकटापणाः॥
en: On this boat ascended Bharata, the mighty Śatrughna, Kausalyā, Sumitrā, and other wives of the king. The priests, and preceptors belonging to the Brāhmaṇa order, has already ascended. After (Bharata and others had got up), ascended the wives of auxiliary princes, and cars and provisions were got on board.

sa: उत्सहेयमतिक्रान्तुं सर्वानाकाशगोचरान्। सागरान् शोषयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम्॥ पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि प्लवमानः प्लवङ्गमः। हरिष्याम्युरुवेगेन प्लवमानो महार्णवम्॥
en: And I can bound beyound's and planets, suck up the oceans, and rive the earth. And a monkey, I can, leaping, crush mountains; and, leaping can drain the mighty ocean dry.

sa: शाश्वतोऽयं सदा धर्मः स्थितोऽस्मासु नरर्षभ। ज्येष्ठ पुत्रे स्थिते राजा न कनीयान् भवेनृपः॥
en: O best of men, even this morality has ever been established with reference to us, viz., that the eldest son of the king existing, a younger one cannot be the king.

sa: मन्ये खलु मया पूर्वं विवत्सा बहवः कृताः। प्राणिनो हिंसिता वापि तन्मामिदमुपस्थितम् ॥
en: I conclude that formerly I deprived many a cow of her calf, and took the life of many creature, and it is for this that the present calamity has befallen me.

sa: ततः समास्थाय रथं महारथः ससारथिर्दाशरथिर्वनं ययौ। उदङ्मुखं तं तु रथं चकार प्रयाणमाङ्गल्यनिमित्तदर्शनात्॥
en: Then placing the car with its face northwards for the purpose of invoking auspiciousness on their journey, that mighty charioteer, Dasaratha's son established on the vehicle, set out for the forest.

sa: किं समर्थे जनस्यास्य किं प्रियं किं सुखावहम्। इति रामेण नगरं पित्रेव परिपालितम्॥
en: What was necessary for this body? What was dear to them and what did they delight in?, (constantly revolving all this in his mind), Rāma ruled this city even as father.

sa: ततः समुत्थाय पुनर्वानरास्ते महाबलाः। विन्ध्यकाननसंकीर्णां विरुदक्षिणां दिशम्॥
en: There rising up, the mighty monkeys again began to range the South close with forests belonging to Vindhya.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राजसिंहस्य वाक्यमद्भुतविस्तरम्। हृष्टरोमा महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत ॥
en: Hearing those astonishing words of that lionlike king, the highly-energetic Viśvāmitra with his down standing on end, said.

sa: उक्तवाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन्नुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ। प्रतिनन्द्य कथां वीरावूचतुर्मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: When the ascetic had spoken thus, both the heroes, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, saluting that first of anchorites, said,

sa: मन्त्रैरभिष्टुतं पुण्यमध्वरेषु द्विजातिभिः॥ हविर्धानेषु यः सोममुपहन्ति महाबलः।
en: Who, possessed of prodigious strength, forcibly takes away the clarified butter sanctified with mantras from the sacrificial ground;

sa: ते शारदाभ्रप्रतिमं श्रीमद्रजतपर्वतम्। शृङ्गवन्तं दरीवन्तमधिरुह्य च वानराः॥
en: And the monkeys ascended the Silvern Hill resembling the autumnal welkin, graceful, and furnished with summits and valleys.

sa: असितोऽल्पबलो राजा कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्। द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतिः॥ एका गर्भविनाशार्थं सपत्न्यै सगरं ददौ।
en: The story runs that his two wives were in the family way; and that with the intention of destroying the embryo of the other, one of them administered poison to the former mixed in her food.

sa: पर्णशालां सुविपुलां तत्र संघातमृत्तिकाम्। सुस्तम्भां मस्करैदीर्धेः कृतवंशां सुशोभनाम्॥ शमीशाखाभिरास्तीर्य दृढपाशावपाशिताम्। कुशकाशशरैः पर्णैः सुपरिच्छादितां तथा॥ समीकृततलां रम्यां चकार सुमहाबलः। निवासं राघवस्यार्थे प्रेक्षणीयमनुत्तमम्॥
en: And the exceedingly stout Lakşmaņa created there for Rāghava a spacious hut thatched with leaves made of clay, furnished with pillars, constructed with long bomboos, graceful-spread with Samī boughs; tightly fastened with strong cords; covered with Kusa reeds, and leaves; with its floor well levelled; and charming; beautiful to look at, and exceedingly excellent.

sa: अथ राजवितीर्णेषु विविधेष्वासलेषु च। राजानमेवाभिमुखा निषेदुर्नियता नृपाः॥
en: Facing and eyeing the monarch, those kings sat them down on different seats pointed out by the former.

sa: ब्राह्मणावसथाश्चैव कर्तव्याः शतशः शुभाः। भक्ष्यान्नपानैर्बहुभिः समुपेताः सुनिष्ठिताः॥
en: Do you rear goodly and comfortable buildings by hundreds for the Brāhmaṇas, replenished with various meats and drinks.

sa: तेन तिष्ठसि विस्रब्धं तमपश्यन् महाद्युतिम्। किं हि संशयमापन्ने तस्मिन्निह मया भवेत्॥ कर्तव्यमिह तिष्ठन्त्या यत्प्रधानस्त्वमागतः।
en: For this it is that you did sit here without anxiety not seeing the highly effulgent (Rāma). Råma, following whom you have repaired to this forest, being in danger, of what avail is life to me.?'

sa: जटायुस्तमतिक्रम्य तुण्डेनास्य खगाधिपः। वामबाहून् दश तदा व्यपाहरदरिंदमः॥
en: Jatayu, the subduer of foes, bearing the strokes, tore into pieces his ten left arms with his beak.

sa: ततस्तु तमसातीरं रम्यमाश्रित्य राघवः। सीतामुद्वीक्ष्य सौमित्रिमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Rāghava pausing on the banks of the Tamasā, looked at Sītā and spoke to Sumitrā's son, saying.

sa: शत्रुघ्नश्च तदाज्ञाय वचनं भृशदुःखितः। अन्तःपुरचरान् सर्वानित्युवाच धृतव्रतः॥
en: At Bharata's command Satrughna observing vows waxing exceedingly aggrieved, addressed all the inmates of the inner apartment, saying.

sa: सामात्यो मन्त्रिसहितः सभृत्य पूजितस्तदा। युक्तः परमहर्षेण वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And being hospitably entertained with his courtiers and counsellors and retainers, he, exceedingly de-lighted, spoke to Vasistha, saying.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैश्चान्यैश्च राघवम्। पूजयित्वा यथाकामं ततोऽगस्त्यस्तमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this, Agastya, according to his desire, worshipping Rāghava with fruits, roots and flowers, said to him,

sa: देवदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पुष्पवर्षां महानभूत्। एवं दत्त्वा सुतां सीता मन्त्रोदकपुरस्कृताम्॥ अब्रवीज्जनको राजा हर्षेणाभिपरिप्लुतः। लक्ष्मणागच्छ भद्रं ते ऊर्मिलामुद्यतां मया॥ प्रतीच्छ पाणिं गृह्णीष्व मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः।
en: And the celestial kettle-drums sounded, and blossoms began to shower down copiously. Having thus given away his daughter Sītä, with water and mantras, king Janaka, overflowing with delight, said, Come forward, O Laksmana, good to you. Receive you Urmilā ready to be bestowed by me upon you. Do you accept her hand: let there be no delay about it.

sa: युञ्जानः स्वानिव प्राणान् प्राणैरिष्टान् सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तः सदा रक्षन् सर्वान् विषयवासिनः॥ प्राप्नोति साश्वती राम कीर्तिं स बहुवार्षिकीम्। ब्रह्मणः स्थानमासाद्य तत्र चापि महीयते॥
en: But he that, setting his heart on protecting the people, dose ever carefully protect all the inhabitants of his dominions, like his own life or like his son dearer to him than life itself, repeat, O Rāma, enduring renown extending over many years, and (at length) attaining the regions of Brahmā, is glorified there.

sa: ततस्तां परुषैर्वाक्यैरभितM महास्वनः। अंकेनाद्य वैदेहीं रथमारोपयत् तदा॥
en: Thereupon, that one emmiting terrible accents, remonstrated with Vaidehī in harsh words and clasping her ascended the car.

sa: ऋषयश्च महात्मानो लोके ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमाः। समेत्य चोचुः सहितास्तेऽन्योन्यं पुण्यकर्मणः॥ स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणानां च लोकानां चेति संस्थिता। जयतां राघवो युद्धे पौलस्त्यान् रजनीचरान्॥ चक्रहस्तो यथा युद्धे सर्वानसुरपुंगवान्।
en: And high-souled saints of the world, and the foremost Brahmarșis of pious acts, coming together, spoke to one another, saying, Hail to cows and Brāhmaṇas, and all those in whom are established the worlds! may Rāghava vanquish in fight those rangers of the night, the progeny of Pulastya, even as the discus-handed Vişņu routed in battle the foremost Asuras!

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः। बभूवुर्हरिशार्दूला विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः॥
en: Hearing his words, those powerful monkeys, with vigour (enhanced, seeing success before them, felt the height of joy.

sa: शिंशुमारोरगगणैर्मीनैरपि च चञ्चलैः॥ विषुद्भिरिव विक्षिप्तैराकाशमभवत् तदा। पाण्डुरैः सलिलोत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा ॥ शारदाधैरिवाकीर्णं गगनं हंससंप्लवैः।
en: And the sky was graced with fast-fleeting porpoises and serpents and fishes resembling playing lightning; and the welkin scattered with pale foam-flakes by thousands, appeared as if it was scattered with autumnal clouds swarming with cranes.

sa: लक्ष्मणं त्वेवमुक्त्वासौ संसिद्धं प्रियराघवम्। सुमित्रा गच्छ गच्छेति पुनः पुनरुवाच तम्॥ राम दशरथं विद्धि मां विद्धि जनकात्मजाम्। अयोध्यामटवीं विद्धि गच्छ तात यथासुखम्॥
en: Do you consider Rāma as Daśaratha, and Janaka's own-begotten as myself; do you regard Ayodhyā as a wilderness, go my son, at your sweet pleasure. Having thus spoken to that dear descendant of Raghu, who had made up his mind (to journey to the forest), Sumitra again and again said to him, “Go! Go!"

sa: सूर्यपुत्रं च सुग्रीवं शक्रपुत्रं च वालिनम्॥ भ्रातरावुपतस्थुस्ते सर्वे च हरियूथपाः। नलं नीलं हनूमन्तमन्यांश्च हरियूथपान्॥ ते तार्क्ष्यबलसम्पन्नः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः। विचरन्तोऽर्दयन् सर्वान् सिंहव्याघ्रमहोरगान्॥
en: All the leaders of monkey-herds stayed with those brothers, Sugriva, the son of the Sun-god and Vali, that of Sakra, and also with Nala, and Nila, and Hanuman, and other leaders of monkey-herds. And endowed with the might of Garuda, and accomplished in fight, they ranged around, pounding lions, and tigers, and mighty Uragas.

sa: ततो विचुक्रुशुस्तत्र वानरा हतयूथपाः। परिदेवयमानास्ते सर्वे प्लवगसत्तमाः॥
en: And thereupon, the monkeys, the foremost of those who go jumping, having lost their chief, bewailed and cried.

sa: एते हि सचिवा राजस्तारप्रभृतयस्तव। पुरवासिजनश्चायं परिवार्य विषीदति॥
en: O king, these your counsellors, your wives headed by Tårā, and all these citizens are bewailing around you.

sa: रावणेनैवमुक्ता तु कुपिता जनकात्मजा। प्रत्युवाचानवद्याङ्गी तमनादृत्य राक्षसम्॥
en: That blameless daughter of Janaka, being thus addressed by Ravana, was highly enraged, and, passing by him, replied.

sa: वृद्धोऽहं त्वं युवा धन्वी सरथः कवची शरी। न चाप्यादाय कुशली वैदेहीं मे गमिष्यसि ॥
en: Old though I am, you shall not be able to carry away with safety Jānakī in my presence, young, accoutred in mails as you are with bow and arrows in your hands and ascending a car.

sa: ततः स्वस्तिकविज्ञेयां पाण्डुकम्बलसंवृताम्। सनन्दिघोषां कल्याणी गुहो नावमुपाहरत्॥
en: And Guha himself brought a graceful barge called Swastika, covered with pale woollen cloth, and resounding with music.

sa: ततस्तेनाप्रमेयेण कपिलेन महात्मना। भस्मराशीकृताः सर्वे काकुत्स्थ सगरात्मजाः॥
en: And then, O Kākutstha, the sons of Sagara were reduced to ashes by the high-souled and incomparable Kapila.

sa: सा त्वां देवि समस्यामि प्रशंसामि च शोभने। प्राप्तराज्ये नरव्याघ्र शिवेन पुनरागते॥ गवां शतसहस्रं च वस्त्राण्यन्नं च पेशलम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यामि तव प्रियचिकीर्षया॥
en: I will, O respected one, bow down to you, O beauteous one, I will hymn you, when, with good fortune returned, the foremost of men has obtained the kingdom, I will to please you give away to Brāhmaṇas hundreds and thousands of kine, cloths, sapid rice, and vessels of wine by thousands, and pillaos.

sa: स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तरुण्यश्च सायं प्रातः समाहिताः। सर्वा देवान्नमस्यन्ति रामस्यार्थे मनस्विनः। तेषां तद् याचितं देवत्वत्प्रसादात्समृद्ध्यताम् ॥
en: Women, old and young, in both the morning and evening, with intent minds, bow down to all the gods on behalf of the intelligent Rāma. Let their desire, O worshipful one, be fulfilled, through your grace.

sa: तेनैवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राघवेण मुनिस्तदा। प्रभावं सरसः क्षिप्रमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Thus accosted by Rāghava, the ascetic then at once began to expatiate over the potency of the pool.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन विश्वामित्रो महातपाः। प्रणिपत्य महादेवं विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Thus addressed by that god, that performer of mighty austerities, Viśvāmitra, bowing down to him, addressed him, saying.

sa: राजभोगाननुभवन् महार्हान् पार्थिवात्मज। विहर त्वमयोध्यायां यथा शक्रस्त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: O king's son, enjoying costly regal pleasures, do you sport in Ayodhyā, like Sakra in the celestial regions.

sa: महाचलनिभैोरैः पनसो नाम यूथपः। आजगाम महावीर्यस्तिसृभिः कोटिभिर्वृतः॥
en: And the leader of herds, named Panasa, of exceeding prowess, came, accompanied with three kotis, mighty and dreadful.

sa: गौतमस्य नरश्रेष्ठ पूर्वमासीन्महात्मनः आश्रमो दिव्यसंकाशः सुरैरपि सुपूजितः॥
en: O foremost of men, this excellent asylum honoured by the celestials themselves, formerly belonged to the high-souled Gautama.

sa: महीध्रकसुतो राजा कीर्तिरातो महाबलः। कीर्तिरातस्य राजर्षेर्महारोमा व्यजायत॥
en: Mahīdhraka's son was king Kirtirāta endowed with great strength. And the Rājarşi Kirtirāta had Mahāroman born to him.

sa: शोभयिष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थमटव्यो रम्यकाननाः। आपगाश्च महानूपाः सानुमन्तश्च पर्वताः॥
en: And romantic forests and woods, watery expanses of mighty volume, and mountains with flat spaces, will grace Kākutstha.

sa: भार्गवश्च्यवनो नाम हिमवन्तमुपाश्रितः। तमृषि साभ्युपागम्य कालिन्दी त्वभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Bhrgu's son named Cyavana was at that time staying in Himavat. Appearing before the sage, Kalindi saluted him.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दस्तुमुलः समजायत॥ तस्य निष्क्रममाणस्य जनौघस्य समन्ततः।
en: And there was caused a great tumult by the crowd gathering around on the issuing out of Rāma.

sa: शीघ्रगस्त्वग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगस्य मरुः सुतः। मरोः प्रशुश्रुकस्त्वासीदम्बरीषः प्रशुश्रुकात्॥
en: Śīghraga was Agnivarņa’s, and Maru was Śīghraga's son. And Maru's son was Prasuśruka, and from Praśuśruka sprung Ambarīşa.

sa: अङ्गारकसमानानां भीमानां भीमकर्मणाम्। विन्ध्याद् वानरकोटीनां सहस्राण्यपतन् द्रुतम्॥
en: And thousands of dreadful monkeys of terrible deeds, hued like charcoal, numbering kot is, rushed suddenly from Vindhya.

sa: ते प्रसन्नोदकां दिव्यां नानाविहगसेविताम्। उपातिजग्मुर्वेगेन शरदण्डां जलाकुलाम्॥
en: And they darted past the Saradanda overflowing with delightful water, beautiful, and haunted by fowls of various kinds.

sa: तास्तदा सविषैर्दष्टाः कुपितैस्तैर्महाशिलाः जज्वलुः पावकोद्दीप्ता विभिदुश्च सहस्रधा॥
en: Big rocks bit by those snakes crumbled into pieces and those fragments began to burn with fire-like venom.

sa: एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण त्रिशङ्कुरपतत् पुनः॥ विक्रोशमानस्त्राहीति विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्।
en: The great Indra having spoken thus, Trisanku fell down, crying to the ascetic Viśvāmitra, 'Save me, save me.'

sa: ततस्तु तारा व्यसनार्णवप्लुता मृतस्य भर्तुर्वदनं समीक्ष्य सा। जगाम भूमिं परिरभ्य वालिनं महादुमं छिन्नमिवाश्रिता लता॥
en: Thereupon, Tārā, sunk in the gulf of disaster, eyeing the countenance of her deceased lord, fell down to the ground embracing Vāli like to a creeper clinging for its support to a mighty but broken tree.

sa: शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। अभिवाद्य मुनीन्सर्वाञ्जनस्थानमुपागमत्॥
en: Śarabhanga having attained to heaven, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, saluting all the ascetics, repaired to Janasthāna.

sa: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः। प्रवरानभितो जघ्नुर्घोररूपा निशाचराः॥
en: In the same way other grim-visaged nightrangers slew with sharpened swords the foremost of monkeys on all sides.

sa: मन्दप्रख्यायमानेन रूपेण रुचिरप्रभाम्। पिनद्धां धूमजालेन शिखामिव विभावसोः॥
en: Her graceful beauty could with great difficulty be perceived lie to the flame of fire enveloped with smoke.

sa: अथापश्यदृषि तत्र दृष्ट्वा चैवमुवाच तम्। स्वागतं तव देवर्षे कालेनैवागतो ह्यसि॥ कोऽयं स्यन्दनमारूढो हप्सरोगणसेवितः। निर्लज्ज इव संयाति भयस्थानं न विन्दति॥ रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु पर्वतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। शृणु वत्स यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्ये चाहं महामते॥
en: And beholding a Rși there he said to him, “Welcome you are, O celestial saint. Indeed you have come at a proper season. Who is this shameless Wight that is going is seated on a car and attended by Apsarās? Does he not perceive his object of fear?" Being thus addressed by Ravana, Parvata said, "O my child, O you gifted with great intellect, Hear I shall describe to you the truth.

sa: स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौ रावणस्यन्दनध्वजः। ध्वजस्योन्मथनं दृष्ट्वा रावणः स महाबलः॥ संप्रदीप्तोऽभवत्क्रोधादमर्षात्प्रदहन्निव। स रोषवशमापन्नः शरवर्ष ववर्ष ह॥
en: Beholding his flag staff thus broken down the highly powerful Răvaņa became ablaze as if burning down the everything with his unbearable ire. And being possessed by wrath he began to make a downpour of shafts.

sa: अथान्यद्वपुरादाय दारुणं घोरदर्शनम्। निष्पपात महातेजाः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥
en: The exceedingly energetic Kumbhakarna endowed with prodigious strength sallied forth, assuming another form terrific and dreadful to behold.

sa: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं सदुमं प्राणहारिणम्। हनूमन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Seeing the enraged Hanumān resembling the Finisher armed with trees and destructive, the Rākşasas began to fly fast.

sa: राघवेण समादिष्टो नीलो हरिचमूपतिः। शशास वानरानीकं यथावत्कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Thus instructed by Rāghava, that powerful monkey, Nila-general of the forces-accordingly issue I his orders to the monkey-hosts.

sa: हरिः शतबलिर्वीरः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः। सर्वामको ह्यवष्टभ्य ररक्ष हरिवाहिनीम्॥
en: The heroic monkey, Satabali, surrounded by ten Kotis (of troops), alone on all sides protected that monkey host.

sa: ततो विस्फारयामास महद्धनुरवस्थितः। उत्ससर्ज च तीक्ष्णग्रान्राक्षसेषु महाशरान्॥
en: Taking up his post, he stretched his great bow and shot terrific sharp-pointed shafts at the Rāks asas.

sa: केशान्कर्णललाटं च नासिकाश्च प्लवंगमाः। रक्षसां दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नखैश्चापि व्यकर्तयन्॥
en: With their sharp teeth and nails they scratched the hair, ears, foreheads and the noses of the Raksasas.

sa: तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्या वानरौघसमावृतः। आश्रितो दक्षिणं पार्श्वमृषभो नाम वानरः॥
en: Let the monkey, named Rşabha, surrounded by numbers of monkeys, post himself at the right of the monkey-army.

sa: राक्षसास्तत्प्लवंगानां शुश्रुवुस्तेऽपि गर्जितम्। नर्दतामिव दृप्तानां मेघानामम्बरे स्वनम्॥
en: The Rākşasas also heard the roars of the monkeys, resembling the rumbling of haughty clouds in the sky.

sa: सीदमानान्सुतान्दृष्ट्वा विह्वलान्स महाबलः। ननाद रावणो हर्षान्महानम्बुधरो यथा॥
en: Beholding Varuņa's sors thus worn out and over-whelmed the highly powerful Rāvana roared in delight like to clouds.

sa: एवं संमन्त्र्य बलिनः सर्वसैन्यमुपासिताः। उद्योगं घोषयित्वा तु सर्वे नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवाः॥ युद्धाय निर्ययुः क्रुद्धाः जम्भवृत्रादयो यथा।
en: Having taken counsel together, those powerful ones conciliated their forces. And proclaiming (their order) that preparations were to be made, all the foremost Nairtas sallied forth for battle, like to those led by Jambha and Vſtra.

sa: तथा प्रविद्धैनाराचैर्मुसलैश्चापि रावणः। अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥
en: In the same way Rāvana showered on Rama great Nárācas and clubs, even as clouds pour down showers.

sa: स शरैराहतस्तेन सरोषो रावणात्मजः। सुप्रयुक्तैस्त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रतिविव्याध लक्ष्मणम्॥
en: And wounded with those shafts, Ravana's son, fired with wrath, pierced Lakşmaņa with arrows discharged (from his bow).

sa: एवमुक्त्वोदधिर्नष्टः समुत्थाय नलस्ततः। अब्रवीद्वानरश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं रामं महाबलम्॥
en: Having delivered himself thus, Ocean disappeared. Then that foremost of monkeys, Nala, arising, spoke to the mighty Rāma.

sa: नैषा रक्षो भवेदद्य मर्यादा हि निसर्गतः। हिरण्यकशिपुः श्रीमान्नमुचिः शम्बरस्तथा॥ निसन्दिधूमकेतुश्च बलिर्वैरोचनोऽपि च। शंभुर्दैत्यो महाराजो वृत्रो बाणस्तथैव च ॥ राजर्षयः शास्त्रविदो गन्धर्वाः समहोरगाः। ऋषयः पन्नगा दैत्या यक्षाश्च ह्यप्सरोगणाः॥ युगान्तपरिवर्ते च पृथिवी समहार्णवा। क्षयं नीता महाराज सपर्वतसरिद्रुमा॥ एते चान्ये च बहवो बलवन्तो दुरासदाः। विनिपन्ना मया दृष्टाः किमुतायं निशाचरः॥
en: Even this is my native might this Räksasa will be no more. Hiranyakasipu, the graceful Namuci, and Sambara, Nişandi and Dhūmaketu and Virocana's offspring Bali, and the Daitya Śambhu that mighty monarchs, Vſtra and Bāņa; and Rājarșis versed in all branches of learnings and Gandharvas, and mighty serpents, and sages, and Pannagas and Yaksas, and swarms of Apsarās and the Earth herself containing vastly oceans and mountains and rivers and trees, at the unrolling of a Yuga all these, O mighty monarch have I brought to dissolution. All these and many more endowed with strength and incapable of being overcome, were at the very sight of me compassed with peril, and what is this ranger of the night?

sa: अवश्यमेभिः सर्वैश्च गन्तव्यं यमसादनम्। तन्निगृणीष्व पौलस्त्य यमं परपुरंजय॥ तस्मिञ्जिते जितं सर्वं भवत्येव न संशयः।
en: These for certain will have to repair to the abode of Yama. Therefore, O Paulastya, O captor of hostile capitals, do you put down Yama. On him being conquered, all will doubtless be conquered by you.

sa: ते चाप्यनुचरास्तस्य चत्वारो भीमविक्रमाः। तेऽपि वर्मायुधोपेता भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः॥
en: And his four attendants of terrible prowess were adorned with excellent ornaments and armed with armours and maces.

sa: प्लवंगानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः। संययौ समरे तस्मिन्विधमन्रावणः शरैः॥
en: Rävaņa with his arrows pursued in conflict destroying the army of monkey as wind dissipate the large clouds.

sa: सिद्धानामपि साध्यानामाश्रयश्चासि पूर्वजः। त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारः परात्परः॥
en: You are the refuge of the Siddhas' and Sadhyas, you Purvaja, ja, the sacrifice, Vasatkara, Om and Paratpara.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम दीनो भ्रष्टामरद्युतिः। इन्द्रश्चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः॥
en: In the interval, O Rāma, Indra became poorly, divested of his immortal brilliance, stricken with anxiety and pensive.

sa: तत्रायुधसहस्राणि तस्मिन्नायोधने भृशम्। राक्षसाः कपिमुख्येषु पातयांचक्रिरे तदा॥
en: In that conflict, the Rākşasas began to incessantly shower ayutas of arms among the flower of the monkeys-army.

sa: राक्षसा वानरेन्द्रेषु विकृताननबाहवः। निवेशयन्तः शस्त्राणि चक्रुस्ते सुमहद्भयम्॥
en: Rākşasas having frightful faces and arms, playing their arms among the foremost monkeys, began to spread terror (there).

sa: स त्वमिन्द्राशनिप्रख्यैः शरैरवकिरन्परान्। अभिद्रवाशु यावद्वै नैतत्कर्म समाप्यते॥
en: Scattering among the foes shafts resembling Indra's thunder-bolt, charge him while he has not yet finished this ceremony.

sa: तद्भवान्स्वपुरं यातु रत्नान्यादाय पार्थिव। भरतश्च सहायार्थ पृष्ठतश्चानुयास्यति॥
en: Taking the jewel, do you proceed to your own city and Bharata as a help shall follow you.
